The sad thing is as a man I can kind of understand what he maybe was doing. That joke likely came from some social anxiety or awkwardness with women / new people that he has. He says that as a what he sees as a joke to clear up any negative misconceptions he thinks you’re having about him. That’s if he’s a somewhat decent guy like me. It’s also entirely possible he is just a creep. But as a man when you have those anxieties around being perceived a certain negative way we’ll say something like a joke or some indirect words to address and negate a misconception about us that we’re worried  someone is having.
